answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 15758 Country: United Kingdom Title: Is there any specific dua for having a baby girl? Are there ahadeeth or any evidence to which our rasool s.a.w has taught us? Also is the age of 42 years too old to have a baby? (Ahlee sunnat wal jamaat akeeda). Please reply as briefly as possible. If there is any specific answer please quote some hadeeth. Jazakallah. Question: Is there any specific dua for having a baby girl? Are there ahadeeth or any evidence to which our rasool s.a.w has taught us? Also is the age of 42 years too old to have a baby? (Ahlee sunnat wal jamaat akeeda). Please reply as briefly as possible. If there is any specific answer please quote some hadeeth. Jazakallah. Answer ID: 15758 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1422/1136=L=1430) We do not remember any dua mentioned in hadith books about birth of baby girl. But, treating daughters with good conduct is promised to be a cause of deliverance from the Fire. The age of 42 is not too old to have a baby. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
